text_en: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah a second time, while he was still confined in the court of the guard:
text_cn: 耶肋米亚还拘禁在监狱的庭院的时候，又有上主的话传给他说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord who made the earth, the Lord who formed it to establish it—the Lord is his name:
text_cn: 那创造形成和奠定大地，且名叫“雅威”的上主这样说：

text_en: Call to me and I will answer you, and will tell you great and hidden things that you have not known.
text_cn: 你呼唤我，我必答复你，把伟大和你不知道的奥秘事情告诉你。

text_en: For thus says the Lord , the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city and the houses of the kings of Judah that were torn down to make a defense against the siege ramps and before the sword:
text_cn: 上主以色列的天主这样论及这城里为围攻工事和武力摧毁的房屋和犹大王宫说──

text_en: The Chaldeans are coming in to fight and to fill them with the dead bodies of those whom I shall strike down in my anger and my wrath, for I have hidden my face from this city because of all their wickedness.
text_cn: 他们前去与加色丁人交战，只不过是将尸体充塞城市，因为我以盛怒杀戮了他们，因了他们的种种罪恶，我已掩面不顾这城市──

text_en: I am going to bring it recovery and healing; I will heal them and reveal to them abundance of prosperity and security.
text_cn: 看，我必使他们的创痍收口痊愈，获得医治；给他们大开和平安宁的宝库；

text_en: I will restore the fortunes of Judah and the fortunes of Israel, and rebuild them as they were at first.
text_cn: 转变犹大和以色列的命运，使他们复兴如初；

text_en: I will cleanse them from all the guilt of their sin against me, and I will forgive all the guilt of their sin and rebellion against me.
text_cn: 洗除他们得罪我的一切罪恶，赦免他们得罪和违背我的一切过犯。

text_en: And this city shall be to me a name of joy, a praise and a glory before all the nations of the earth who shall hear of all the good that I do for them; they shall fear and tremble because of all the good and all the prosperity I provide for it.
text_cn: 这城必使我在普世万民间获得喜庆、赞美和光荣；他们听到我对这城行的一切善事，必因我赐给这城的种种幸福与和平，起敬起畏。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : In this place of which you say, “It is a waste without human beings or animals, ” in the towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem that are desolate, without inhabitants, human or animal, there shall once more be heard
text_cn: 上主这样说：“在你们所谓人兽绝迹的荒野地方，在犹大的城市和耶路撒冷，没有居民和牲畜的荒凉街上，

text_en: the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voices of those who sing, as they bring thank offerings to the house of the Lord : “Give thanks to the Lord of hosts, for the Lord is good, for his steadfast love endures forever! ” For I will restore the fortunes of the land as at first, says the Lord .
text_cn: 人还要听到愉快和喜乐的声音，新郎和新娘的声音；还要听见在上主殿宇奉献感恩祭的人说：请你们赞颂万军的上主，因为上主是美善的，他的慈爱永远常存；因为我要转变这地的命运，使它复兴如初──上主说。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: In this place that is waste, without human beings or animals, and in all its towns there shall again be pasture for shepherds resting their flocks.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“在这人兽绝迹的荒凉地方，和其中所有的城市里，仍要有牧童牧放羊群的牧场；

text_en: In the towns of the hill country, of the Shephelah, and of the Negeb, in the land of Benjamin, the places around Jerusalem, and in the towns of Judah, flocks shall again pass under the hands of the one who counts them, says the Lord .
text_cn: 在山地和平原以及南部的各城镇里，在本雅明地，在耶路撒冷城郊，在犹大的各城市里，仍要有人数点手下经过的羊群──上主说。”

text_en: The days are surely coming, says the Lord , when I will fulfill the promise I made to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.
text_cn: “看时日将到──上主的断语──我要实践我对以色列家和犹大家预许赐福的诺言。

text_en: In those days and at that time I will cause a righteous Branch to spring up for David; and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.
text_cn: 在那些日子里，在那时期内，我必由达味出生一正义的苗芽，在地上执行公道和正义；

text_en: In those days Judah will be saved and Jerusalem will live in safety. And this is the name by which it will be called: “The Lord is our righteousness. ”
text_cn: 在那时日里，犹大必获救，耶路撒冷必居享安宁，人用以称呼她的名字将是：‘上主是我们的正义。’

text_en: For thus says the Lord : David shall never lack a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel,
text_cn: 因为上主这样说：达味总不断有人坐在以色列家的宝座上；

text_en: and the levitical priests shall never lack a man in my presence to offer burnt offerings, to make grain offerings, and to make sacrifices for all time.
text_cn: 肋未司祭也总不断有人站在我前奉献全燔祭，焚烧祭品，天天杀牲举祭。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
text_cn: 有上主的话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord : If any of you could break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night, so that day and night would not come at their appointed time,
text_cn: “上主这样说：假若你们能破坏我与白日黑夜订立的盟约，使白日黑夜不再依循自己的时序，

text_en: only then could my covenant with my servant David be broken, so that he would not have a son to reign on his throne, and my covenant with my ministers the Levites.
text_cn: 那我与我仆达味的盟约也就可以破坏，使他再没有儿子继位为王；我与我的仆役肋未司祭的盟约，也就可以破坏。

text_en: Just as the host of heaven cannot be numbered and the sands of the sea cannot be measured, so I will increase the offspring of my servant David, and the Levites who minister to me.
text_cn: 我要这样增添我仆达味的后裔和服事我的肋未人，有如天上数不清的军旅，海中量不尽的沙粒。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah:
text_cn: 有上主的话传给耶肋米亚说：

text_en: Have you not observed how these people say, “The two families that the Lord chose have been rejected by him, ” and how they hold my people in such contempt that they no longer regard them as a nation?
text_cn: “难道你没有注意这人民说些什么话吗？他们说：上主拣选了两个家族，如今他又把他们抛弃了！ 他们竟这样轻视我的人民，不再把他们看作一个民族。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : Only if I had not established my covenant with day and night and the ordinances of heaven and earth,
text_cn: 上主这样说：假若我没有与白日黑夜订立盟约，没有给上天下地设立轨道，

text_en: would I reject the offspring of Jacob and of my servant David and not choose any of his descendants as rulers over the offspring of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. For I will restore their fortunes, and will have mercy upon them.
text_cn: 我就可以抛弃雅各伯与我仆达味的后裔，不再由他的后裔选拔人，来统治亚巴郎、依撒格和雅各伯的后裔，因为我必要怜悯他们，转变他们的命运。”
